newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi bourse opening delayed by technical snag.
newsitem.headline: Delhi bourse opening delayed by technical snag.

text.p: The opening of trade on the Delhi Stock Exchange was delayed on Wednesday by a technical snag, officials said.

Delhi Stock Exchange senior general manager Kameshwar Swarup told Reuters he expected trading on the computerised bourse to start by 10.45 a.m. (0515 GMT), one hour later than the normal opening time of 9.45 a.m. (0415 GMT).
On Tuesday, the bourse's benchmark index closed 13.32 points higher at 837.05.
